data.standardized_narrative: The report indicates that prior closed years (2001-2012) ran off satisfactorily during 2015, with most prior years contributing releases that supported a positive closed-year result. No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement amount is disclosed in the notes; narrative references point to favourable development and stable reserves on a few named losses (notably MH370). The balance sheet shows a reduction in total gross claims outstanding from $421,809k at 1 Jan 2015 to $331,302k at 31 Dec 2015, but a gross prior-year re-estimation figure is not explicitly provided in the required 'movement in prior year's provision' format.

This includes movement on the closed years of account.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position comparative (31 Dec 2014) and expressed in millions (USD). No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure is present in the notes in the required format; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. The claims outstanding reconciliation and P&L rows referencing 'claims incurred in prior underwriting year' are present but per extraction rules these are not acceptable as the authoritative prior-year reserve movement figure, so they were not used. A gross reduction in total claims outstanding is visible on the balance sheet (421,809 -> 331,302) but that aggregate change includes current year activity and exchange movements and therefore was not used as the prior-year development figure. A loss-ratio development table (gross and net percentages) is present and provided in the claims triangle section but underwriting-year premium breakout required to convert those ratios to absolute gross amounts by year is not available in the format needed; hence PYD could not be computed from the triangle without additional per-year premium data.
